name: Dots
summary: Put an always-on agent to work across connected apps to draft content, investigate feedback, and prepare work for review. It has its own cloud computer and is rolling out to Pro users in eligible markets.

name: GPT-6.1 Sol
summary: Build coding and computer-use agents with near-Astra capability at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens. It is available now in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work for paid plans.

name: Codex Cloud
summary: Run coding tasks in a reusable cloud environment and review changes from desktop, web, or phone while your laptop sleeps. Available now on Plus and higher plans.

name: Plugin Extensions
summary: Give your plugin a sidebar app, a panel beside chat, or a custom file viewer. Developers can build native ChatGPT interfaces with the TypeScript or Python SDK, and extensions are available on all plans.

name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
summary: Build apps, fix bugs, and produce polished documents with a faster everyday model. It is live in Claude and the API at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, and typically uses fewer tokens per task than Sonnet 5.

name: Holo4 35B-A3B
summary: Build agents that operate apps through screenshots, code, APIs, and MCP tools. Apache-licensed weights and 4-bit downloads are available now, along with a hosted API priced at $0.30 input and $2 output per million tokens.

name: Whiteboard
summary: Review agent-written code on a visual canvas that links diagrams and decision traces to source files. The free, MIT-licensed desktop app connects to Codex or Claude Code and shows focused diffs of what changed.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
summary: Design a voice by describing it, pick from 2,000-plus stock voices, or clone one from 30 seconds of audio across 100-plus languages. A cheaper Flash-Lite TTS ships alongside, both live now in the Gemini API and AI Studio.
